intent: Add OAuth2 GitHub login to our existing FastAPI app

nodes.title: Research FastAPI OAuth library
nodes.description: Compare OAuth libraries and select an implementation approach for GitHub login.
nodes.prompt_template: For fixture developer-oauth, complete node `research_oauth_library`: Compare OAuth libraries and select an implementation approach for GitHub login. Return the outputs and verify each acceptance criterion.
acceptance_criteria: At least two libraries are evaluated.
assumptions: Maintained libraries are preferred over custom OAuth code.

nodes.title: Review current auth flow
nodes.description: Map existing login, JWT issuance, user linking, and protected route behavior.
nodes.prompt_template: For fixture developer-oauth, complete node `review_current_auth_flow`: Map existing login, JWT issuance, user linking, and protected route behavior. Return the outputs and verify each acceptance criterion.
acceptance_criteria: JWT issuance and validation paths are documented.
assumptions: Existing tests cover the common login path.
unknowns: Edge cases around linked GitHub accounts are unknown.

nodes.title: Implement GitHub OAuth endpoints
nodes.description: Add login and callback endpoints, state validation, and account linking for GitHub OAuth.
nodes.prompt_template: For fixture developer-oauth, complete node `implement_oauth_endpoints`: Add login and callback endpoints, state validation, and account linking for GitHub OAuth. Return the outputs and verify each acceptance criterion.
acceptance_criteria: User can initiate GitHub OAuth login.
Callback validates state and stores authenticated identity.
assumptions: GitHub client values will be supplied through existing secret management.
unknowns: Redirect URI per environment needs confirmation.

nodes.title: Assess session invalidation risk
nodes.description: Document migration, rollback, and user-impact risks before changing session behavior.
nodes.prompt_template: For fixture developer-oauth, complete node `risk_session_invalidation`: Document migration, rollback, and user-impact risks before changing session behavior. Return the outputs and verify each acceptance criterion.
acceptance_criteria: User impact of session changes is described.
assumptions: JWT removal is not required for initial OAuth launch.
unknowns: Number of active JWT sessions is unknown.

nodes.title: Review OAuth rollout readiness
nodes.description: Review code, tests, configuration, and rollback notes before production rollout.
nodes.prompt_template: For fixture developer-oauth, complete node `oauth_rollout_review`: Review code, tests, configuration, and rollback notes before production rollout. Return the outputs and verify each acceptance criterion.
unknowns: Production rollout window is not set.

nodes.title: Approve JWT removal
nodes.description: Human technical gate before removing or disabling JWT authentication.
nodes.prompt_template: Human approval gate: review the inputs, verify each acceptance criterion, and explicitly approve before successor nodes proceed.
acceptance_criteria: Tech lead explicitly approves removal before code changes.
unknowns: Approval owner may be a tech lead or security reviewer.

nodes.title: Remove JWT auth after approval
nodes.description: Disable or remove JWT login only after the approval gate passes.
nodes.prompt_template: For fixture developer-oauth, complete node `remove_jwt_auth`: Disable or remove JWT login only after the approval gate passes. Return the outputs and verify each acceptance criterion.
acceptance_criteria: JWT endpoint behavior is intentionally removed or guarded.
assumptions: Removal is a later phase, not part of initial OAuth enablement.
FastAPI routes can add GitHub OAuth without immediately removing existing JWT login.
unknowns: Exact auth library choice and session storage changes need review.
blind_spots: assumption: existing FastAPI app can support server-side OAuth sessions
unknown: active JWT session count is not known
risk: login changes can lock out existing users
gate: JWT removal requires explicit technical approval
open_questions: Which OAuth library should be selected?
What session migration strategy is safest?

handoff.instructions: Start at `research_oauth_library` and follow edges in genome.json. Do not assume answers for listed unknowns; stop at human gates for approval.
